rationale: Massive Ukrainian drone attack on Moscow (450 drones, two deaths) marks a significant escalation in the regional war, directly affecting Black Sea security environment. Score adjusted down: ongoing situation without qualitative change.

top_events.title: Largest attack on Moscow sees Ukraine fire hundreds of drones, mayor says
top_events.label: Ukraine launches 450-drone strike on Moscow
top_events.summary: Ukraine conducted its largest drone attack on Moscow with 450 drones, killing two people. This escalation in deep-strike operations affects regional security dynamics in the Black Sea area.

top_events.title: Nato welcomes Greenland deal as Trump says it will give US 'permanent security control'
top_events.label: US Denmark finalize Greenland security deal
top_events.summary: Denmark and the US signed a Greenland security agreement after Trump's annexation threats. NATO welcomed the deal, though its impact on European security remains unclear.

top_events.title: Houthis say they targeted Saudi capital with ballistic missiles
top_events.label: Houthis strike Riyadh airport with missiles
top_events.summary: Houthi ballistic missiles hit a fuel depot at Riyadh airport, causing flight delays. Saudi Arabia reports intercepting a missile aimed at the capital.

short_summary: Ukraine drones strike Moscow oil refinery

most_significant_event.label: Ukraine drones strike Moscow oil refinery
most_significant_event.summary: Ukrainian drones hit Moscow region oil refinery, killing two. Moscow claims 450 drones intercepted in unprecedented attack, escalating war near Romania's Black Sea region.
